headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest or declining performance.
summary: Coforge led revenue expansion with 53.6% YoY growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS showed solid profit growth, helped by AI revenue contributions. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% top‑line growth. Wipro and Persistent recorded profit declines despite revenue gains.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI as a key growth driver, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Coforge raised its FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16% and HCLTech maintained an operating margin above 18%.

themes.title: Dividend continuity
themes.detail: Most companies announced or maintained interim dividends, signalling cash‑flow stability.
